title: Book Three · Chapter 68: The Rain Between Shops
story:
On Saturday, Ronan takes another finished garment to a shop near the library.

Mum finished Mrs Deng's brother's coat on Wednesday. He collected it himself that afternoon.

The morning starts dry. By the time he comes out, rain is falling across the pavement.

He stops beneath the shop roof and checks the empty cloth bag. A few drops have reached one corner.

Someone calls his name.

Anna stands at the library door with an umbrella. Her bag is full, and a large book presses against one side.

“This way?” she asks.

Ronan points toward West Lane.

“Part of the way.”

She opens the umbrella. He steps beside her, with the cloth bag on his outer arm.

The pavement is narrow between the shop fronts. They walk slowly so the umbrella does not hit the people coming toward them.

Ronan reaches for its handle.

“I can hold it.”

Anna gives it to him. He lifts it a little higher. The edge stops touching her hair.

“Better,” she says.

Rain makes a quick sound above them. A cart passes in the road. Water runs along the edge of the pavement.

Anna looks at his empty bag.

“Work?”

“A coat. Only the walk was mine.”

“Your mother did the rest.”

“Yes. Mrs Deng's brother wanted a pocket. I only had to carry the question.”

Anna smiles. “A lighter job.”

They stop at a crossing. Ronan holds the umbrella over both bags as well as he can.

Anna moves closer. Her shoulder presses gently against his coat. He looks straight ahead at the road.

“You are getting wet,” she says.

“Only one side.”

She takes his sleeve and draws him under the umbrella. The wet edge of his coat touches her bag.

“Now neither side needs to,” she says.

Ronan moves the handle a little toward the middle. Anna's book is close to his arm.

“Shall I carry that?”

“I have it. You have the umbrella.”

He nods and keeps the handle steady. Both bags are under the umbrella now.

They wait while a woman passes with a wide basket. Anna steps nearer the wall, and Ronan follows her.

There is a little room for each of them. Neither can take the long steps they use on the track.

“Slow today,” he says.

“We have more to carry.”

A drop lands on his hand. He looks up at the edge, then back at the road.

Anna is smiling. He wants to keep talking, but for a few steps, nothing comes.

They listen to the rain together. The woman goes past. Anna moves back toward the centre of the pavement. Ronan goes with her.

The road clears. They cross together and go past the bread shop.

Ronan wants the walk to be longer. At the next corner, Anna needs the road to her home. West Lane is the other way.

He hands the umbrella back.

“I can wait under the shop roof.”

She looks at the rain. It is lighter now.

“I would walk you farther, but I need to take these books home.”

“I know.”

She smiles and goes along her road. Ronan stays beneath the roof until the heaviest drops stop.

Then he walks home with the empty bag folded inside his coat.

Mum looks at his wet sleeve and gets a dry cloth. Ronan tells her the garment reached the customer before the rain.

“Good timing,” she says.

He takes the cloth and dries his hands. For a moment, he can still feel Anna's fingers on his sleeve.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pavement＝人行道；outer＝外侧的；umbrella handle＝伞柄；lighter＝较轻的（本章也用于雨势变小）。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan是否让送到顾客那里的衣服淋湿了？和Anna同行时，他帮忙做了什么？
2. 两人为什么没有一路走到同一个家？Ronan对这段短路程有什么感受？

## 读句子

**He lifts it a little higher.**

拆开看：He / lifts it / a little higher.

他／把伞举起来／举高一点。
